subject: Depotix: conditional audit-log sunset + keystore handoff coordination
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@depotix.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.com
Cc: nadia.singh@depotix.com, legal@depotix.com
Date: Fri, 1 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Question on audit/session log sunset and keystore handback

Hi Chloe,

Quick one from our compliance team — we run periodic legal holds and for a specific product line we need an extended debug/audit log window of 90 days for a short period (anticipated 60–90 days) while we complete a regulatory review. Our default in Prod is 30d ephemeral session logs; would Redwood be open to a temporary, account-scoped extension for Depotix?

We also need clarity on keystore handback: if we request a handback of tenant encryption keys for the affected slices at the end of the hold, what’s the process and evidence you can provide that keys and any derivatives were removed from Redwood storage?

I attached a short request form that includes the tenant IDs and the regulatory dates. Let me know what information you need from us.

Thanks,
Liam
Director, InfoSec — Depotix

Attachment: depotix-retention-request-20280901.pdf (application/pdf, 56KB)

From: chloe_martin@redwood.com
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@depotix.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 1 Sep 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question on audit/session log sunset and keystore handback

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear ask and the tenant list. We can support a temporary, scoped extension but there are a few conditions we need to align on:

- Timebox: we can approve a one-time extension up to 90 days, after which logs return to your account's baseline retention.
- Scope: extension will apply to the tenant IDs listed in your PDF only; other tenants unaffected.
- Evidence: we will provide an attestation bundle and a proof-of-delete manifest for the keystore handback (see below for what we include).
- Pricing & operational impact: there is a small operational surcharge and we may require reserved capacity or burst capacity to ensure no latency impact — I’ll include options.

Next steps: can Depotix sign a short addendum (DocuSign) authorizing the temporary retention extension and confirming legal justification? Once signed, we’ll route to Ops and Security to schedule the privileged handoff and proof artifacts.

Looping in Kimberly (security) and Priya (legal/compliance) to scope the evidence pack and the keystore procedure.

—Chloe
Chloe Martin
Account Lead, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: (none)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: chloe_martin@redwood.com
Cc: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 4 Sep 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Depotix: conditional audit-log sunset + keystore handoff coordination

Chloe / team —

We reviewed Depotix's request. Proposed evidence bundle (preliminary):

- A signed addendum (DocuSign) authorizing the 90d extension and tenant scope.
- An artifacts zip containing: system export of the retained session logs (timestamped), an operation timeline (who performed the retention change), and an immutable hash list for the exported files.
- Keystore handback proof: a signed manifest listing key IDs, key wrapping metadata, and a HSM-backed key deletion attestation showing the deletion event and HSM audit entries (when applicable).
- SOC 2 artifacts: control mappings for logging/retention (we can include the relevant SOC 2 control descriptions and the auditor summary excerpt). I’ll prepare a trimmed SOC2 evidence pack for Depotix; we should avoid sending full audit reports.

Operational notes: we will perform the keystore export/handback in a maintenance window; keys exported to Depotix's provided secure S3 bucket (customer-owned) and then a documented deletion routine will run. Priya — can Legal draft the addendum language? Also confirming: any requirement for escrow/retention longer than 90d will need engineering approval and a separate SLA.

Attachments referenced: soc2-evidence-pack.zip (attachment will be staged after addendum)

-Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@depotix.com>, chloe_martin@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 7 Sep 2028 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Depotix: conditional audit-log sunset + keystore handoff coordination

Liam — thanks, we prepared the addendum and the process summary. Summary of commitments from Redwood if Depotix signs:  

1) We will enable a tenant-scoped retention extension to 90 days for the tenant IDs in your attachment for a single, timeboxed period ending 2028-12-01.
2) We will export the affected keystore entries to the secure bucket you provide, deliver a signed manifest of exported key IDs (including key wrap metadata), and run a deletion routine; deletion will be reflected in an HSM audit log excerpt included in the proof bundle.
3) We will deliver an artifacts bundle within 7 business days after the end of the extension window that includes the log export manifest, hash proofs, and the keystore deletion attestation.
4) There is a one-time operational surcharge of $1,250 and potential short-term capacity reservation if requested.

Please review the DocuSign link (below), sign to accept the addendum, and provide the secure S3 endpoint and the access procedure you prefer. Once signed, Ops will schedule the maintenance window and Kimberly will stage the SOC2 evidence subset.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/some-doc-id-DEPOTIX-RETENTION
GDrive evidence folder (staged): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1DepotixEvidence

If Depotix needs a different acceptance workflow (legal PO instead of DocuSign), tell us and we’ll adapt.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-ephemeral-retention-addendum-v1.pdf (application/pdf, 12KB)
